Credit Note — Lines

This screen displays individual line items from all credit notes in one consolidated view, allowing you to analyze credited products, services, and amounts across your entire credit note history.

Each row represents a single line item from a credit note, showing details such as the item, quantity, unit price, and total amount credited.

Use this view to track which items are most frequently credited, identify patterns in returns or adjustments, and analyze credit note trends by customer, date range, or other criteria.
